independent_unit: owner with source-family cluster; prefix is a paired repeated measure

C.question: Does G preserve subject, stage, time and optional non-use for identical evidence?

E.unreachable_or_pending: remain missing with reason, never zero; report coverage

F.question: What extra time does the user actually wait?
F.status: not_run; CPU checks are not model latency evidence

rs_comparison.materials: same small source-reviewed low-risk method set; method+case shares the exact retrieved method with method-only
rs_comparison.pilot: four development prefixes from different owners, outcome-blind selection after applicability review; at most 12 new RS alternative responses plus shared R0
rs_comparison.material_availability: pending; existing eight annotation classes are not method cards
rs_comparison.resident_cost: charge always-present prompt tokens, prefill and context; it is not the resource-free OFF
rs_comparison.case_only: current bank-v0 RS is a separate historical-engineering comparator

generator_comparison.SupportPlan: same evidence, private plan references public read ordinals only, use does not require mentioning, count plan tokens/calls/time
generator_comparison.G1: requires actual training and held-out owner/family data; training uses optional-ignore/OFF-better as well as relevant evidence; independent preference qualification
generator_comparison.selection_rule: freeze G weights/backend before resource-gain results; prompt-comparison selection uses development data and separate confirmation

analysis.technical_failure: pending/unavailable; keep attempts, reasons and costs; no zero reward or selective retry
analysis.semantic_failure: retain as observed outcome; do not delete because resource harmed the reply
analysis.clusters: owner and shared source family; report actual independent counts and uncertainty, no 54-sample pseudo-independence
analysis.exposure: these pilots are formative; independent confirmation needs frozen unconsumed material or explicitly disclosed same-corpus limitations
analysis.promotion_rule: A does not certify B; B does not certify C; C does not certify D/E; D/E do not establish F
